p.title: Live invariant check accepts the shared-Worker-only AI policy
p.symptom: Pages deploys of v57.16 published correctly but ended in failure at 'Verify live standing invariants': 'live public AI config exposes an HTTPS shared fallback or an explicit disabled state' with serverMode/chatPolicy 'shared-worker-only'.
p.root_cause: P1421 renamed the published AI route policy to shared-worker-only; ci-live-invariant-check.mjs still required 'shared-worker-fallback' / 'personal-key-or-public-worker', a combination no producer writes any more. It only surfaced once the Worker route was healthy and published.
p.fix: The invariant accepts the current shared-worker-only names (and the older names for configs published before P1421); the health, source-SHA and output-cap checks are unchanged.
p.violated_rule: A policy rename updates every gate that reads the policy.
p.prevention: The live invariant now passes against the live site with the current config; the other P1421 gates already used the new names.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-live-invariant-check.mjs against https://ysnle.github.io/aio-screener: OK (version v57.16, 4 operator-required header warnings).

changelog: **배포 확인 검사 갱신 (P1448):** AI 경로 정책 이름이 바뀐 뒤에도 예전 이름을 기대해 매 배포 확인이 실패하던 검사를 현재 정책에 맞췄습니다.
